about: The layout options shared by the Camera Commander (drawn by the compositor, edited on the Camera Commander page) and the Tablet Layout (laid out in the browser, edited in Lovelace): one engine, two places (compositor.commander_layout, integration/cards/src/layout.ts, checked against tests/layout_cases.json). Each option: label, help ({item} is camera or card), default, and `for` when only one of them has it. Read by the compositor's defaults, the admin page and the cards' editors.

gap.label: Gap, px
gap.help: The room between tiles and panels.

margin.label: Margin, px
margin.help: Room left clear all round the whole area, like the gap but at its edges.

main_fit.label: Fit
main_fit.help: Fit: the {item} whole, in the middle of the space (around it, the background shows through). Fill: stretched to the space. Crop: fills it, edges cut off. Own shape: Main width wide at the {item}'s own shape, the panels around it (they move when its shape changes). Fixed shape: Main width wide at the shape set, the {item} whole within it.

main_width.label: Main width, %
main_width.help: Of the whole width; the panels share the room around it.

panel_min.label: Smallest panel, %
panel_min.help: A panel with {item}s keeps at least this much; the main {item} shrinks (same shape) rather than squeeze it out.

header_space.label: Space above the header, px
header_space.help: Room above the view's header (its heading card and badges), when it has one; Home Assistant's own is 24.

narrow_below.label: Phone layout below, px
narrow_below.help: Narrower than this (a phone), the view is Home Assistant's own sections instead: one column that scrolls, the main panel first, garnish left out. 0: always the Tablet Layout.

main_least.label: Main camera at least, %
main_least.help: The smallest the main camera may be, as a share of the biggest it could be in the space, shown whole. Cameras go into +n more before it gets smaller than this.

main_most.label: Main camera at most, %
main_most.help: Beyond this the room goes to bigger tiles. The same measure as the least.

tile_loss.label: A camera may lose up to, %
tile_loss.help: How far a tile may be from the tile shape, and the main camera's place from 16:9, which is how much of a camera of that shape is cropped. A camera is cropped about its centre, never squeezed.

tile_min.label: Smallest tile, px
tile_min.help: The narrowest a tile may be. Smaller than this, a camera can't be made out.

tile_shape.label: Tile shape
tile_shape.help: Every tile is held near this shape. A camera of another shape is cropped about its centre.

edges.label: Edges, in the order they fill
edges.help: The edges the tiles go on. The first cameras go on the first edge.

edges_tall.label: Different when the space is taller than wide
edges_tall.help: A second list of edges, used when the space is taller than it is wide.

main_other.label: A main camera of another shape
main_other.help: What a main camera does when its shape is not its place's. Crop to fill and Show whole never move a tile when the main camera changes; Fit the layout to it can.

cant_fit.label: When the limits can't all be met
cant_fit.help: Find something that fits allows other edges, then a smaller main camera, then smaller tiles. Keep to my limits shows the main camera alone and says so.

size.label: Size
size.help: Left and right: its width. Top and bottom: its height. In % of the view's, or in px (at most 45% of the view's: a smaller screen gets less).

unit.label: Size in
unit.help: % of the view: grows and shrinks with the screen. px: the same on any screen.

lines.label: Lines
lines.help: Columns (left, right) or rows (top, bottom) its {item}s are shared between, the first taking one more when they don't share evenly.

fit.label: Fit
fit.help: Fill: equal tiles, each {item} filling its own. Whole: equal tiles, each {item} whole in its own. Stack, Reverse, Centre: each {item} whole at its own shape, edge to edge, from the start, against the end, or in the middle; the spare room is left clear (too many to fit: all shrink alike). Same size: tiles all of one size and of the Tile shape (square, 16:9…), each {item} cropped to fill its own, as thick as the panel (shared by its lines), in the middle; Same size, spread: the same, the spare room shared evenly between them and at both ends.

cell.label: Tile shape
cell.help: Width:height of every tile, for Same size: 1:1 for squares, 16:9 for most cameras (none cropped).

anchor_left.label: To the left edge
anchor_left.help: On: it runs to the view's edge and Left stops at it. Off: it stops at Left.

anchor_right.label: To the right edge
anchor_right.help: On: it runs to the view's edge and Right stops at it. Off: it stops at Right.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.help: Off the view entirely: no room, no tiles; its {item}s kept for when it is shown again.

hide_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_empty.help: No card of it showing (each card's own visibility, or a Casa Mia section with nothing to show): it takes no room. Off: its room is kept, empty.
